title: VERA: A Responsible AI Dashboard for Assessing LLM Deployments in Light of the EU AI Act
reasoning: The paper introduces a dashboard (VERA) for assessing LLM deployments by running existing public benchmarks to evaluate criteria such as robustness, bias, toxicity, and privacy in compliance with the EU AI Act. While it mentions religion in the introduction as an example of a social group that can be affected by bias, it does not have a focused component evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethical reasoning.
